🎯 Slot Predictor — BTTS & O/U 2.5
Observes the 1st slot of a quarter/segment row, then applies the selected Prediction Mode to predict slot 2. If slot 2 is wrong, repeats the prediction at slot 3. Normal: always predicts the opposite of slot 1. Inverted: always predicts the same as slot 1. Auto: starts in Normal, switches to Inverted when accuracy drops below 50% (requires ≥10 predictions). Activates only when ≥36 matches entered and both outcomes appear in ≥70% of complete hours (Hours Active row in the pivot table) for the selected quarter/segment. Threshold is adjustable.
